meta.title: Beyond the Veil · Celebrate your most expressed self
meta.description: A private, alcohol-free Halloween gathering at HAVAN, October 31 to November 1, 2026. Two stages until sunrise.

event.calendar_location: HAVAN, 17301 Flint Rock Rd, Austin, TX 78738

hero.title: Beyond the Veil
hero.subtitle: Cross over. Celebrate your most expressed self. Dance till sunrise.

paragraphs: You have been invited to join us this Halloween for a truly transformational gathering we call **Beyond the Veil.**
On the 31st of October, as the sun goes down and the veil between worlds thins, **a gate will open in the hills of Austin** to an estate that will become our playground.

For centuries, people have gathered at this time of year to mark the turning from harvest to winter and to honor those who came before. Disguises were worn as a way to walk between worlds, to become someone else for one night and pass unrecognized among the spirits.
This year, we're giving you a permission slip to wear a disguise that **does the opposite.** Create a costume that celebrates the bigness of your expression.

feature: This event is your canvas, and your gifts are the paint.
Be bold, be wild, and play BIG!!

paragraphs: Inside the gates, every expression is honored: your movement, your voice, your dance, and your essence.
As we move beyond the veil, let the friction fall away, _let your “try” die, and let your gifts live._
Everything you need to walk between worlds is below: the flow of the night, inspiration for your costume, how to buy tickets, ride-sharing options and parking.
invitation.closing: See you on the other side…

flow.name: The Arrival
flow.text: Step through the gate into an estate transformed for one night. Get your portrait taken by our professional photographer, wander the grounds, and take in a crowd of people who came to play. Doors close at 8 sharp so the whole room crosses together.

flow.name: The Gathering
flow.text: Two hundred of us gather outside under the night sky. This is the moment a room full of costumes becomes one community.

flow.name: The Crossing
flow.text: An opening ceremony created for this night only, led by Leah Free. We set the tone, name how we'll care for each other, and cross the veil together. Nobody walks into this party alone.

flow.name: The Night
flow.text: Two stages of Austin's best DJs, bass and house, from 9 until the sun comes up. Phones go away at 9, so you're fully in it, with nothing between you and the music.

flow.name: The Performances
flow.text: This isn't a house party with a playlist. Catch Spooky Halloween Story Time with Brent Pella, a comedy experience, and a live song and dance performance by Natalie Porretta and Zoe Dane.

flow.name: The Witching Hour
flow.text: A special performance at the stroke of midnight. We're not telling you what it is. You'll want to be on the dance floor when it starts.

flow.name: The Extra Hour
flow.text: The clocks fall back. While the rest of the city gets an extra hour of sleep, you get an extra hour on the dance floor.

flow.name: First Light
flow.text: Sunshine plays the sunrise set as the sky over the hills turns gold. You'll greet the first morning of November with the people who danced through the night beside you.

music.intro: We will have two stages on site with some of Austin's best DJs.

agreement.title: The Group Agreement
agreement.intro: This is a curated guest list. Everyone here was invited because we trust them to care for the room and the people in it.
agreement.lead: Consent matters here, from personal space to photos. By attending, you agree to:

items.v: Ask before you hug, touch, or photograph someone.
A no, or a change of mind, is honored right away, with no questions asked.
If you're not sure, the answer is no.

agreement.outro: We'll open the night by naming these agreements together at the opening ceremony. Anyone who doesn't honor them will be asked to leave.

costume.title: Outfit / Dress
costume.lead: This night is asking you to GO BIG, so treat your costume creation as part of the experience, not an afterthought.

points.v: Start now, use the moodboard and Etsy idea links below, and order anything you need early so you're not scrambling at the last moment for a long-shot Etsy delivery.
Step out of your comfort zone, and show up as the version of you that finally got the permission slip to be unapologetically yourself.

You'll be moving through different energies and spaces and even spending time outdoors at times, so wear layers you can shed as it unfolds. We'll have plenty of places for coats, bags and your extra items to be stored.

costume.warning: A last-minute costume-in-a-bag from Amazon IS NOT what we're doing here. If you show up in a zero-effort onesie, expect to be playfully roasted and sent to the costume corner to change before you cross the veil.
costume.warning_after: You got this... we believe in you! ;)

items.t: Black and silver angel-wing fringe cape

light.title: The light side of the veil
light.lead: This isn't a typical Halloween. We're crossing into the luminous side of the spirit realm: angels, celestial beings, starlight, moon goddesses. Think uplifting, radiant and beautiful, not dark and dreary.
noshame: No stress. Keep the base and lift it toward the light: swap the blood for shimmer, and add silver, pearl, a halo, wings or a veil.
Bring it, just let it catch the light.

venue.title: The Venue
venue.text: Beyond the Veil is hosted at HAVAN, a private estate in west Austin/Lakeway chosen for its beauty, intimacy and spaciousness.
venue.name: HAVAN
venue.start: Please arrive during the arrival window (7 to 8 PM) to preserve the integrity and flow of the experience.
parking: Parking at HAVAN is very limited, so we're offering a small number of parking passes for $50 per car. Add one to your order at checkout.
Only cars with a parking pass will be allowed on the property, so if you don't have one, please rideshare or arrange a drop-off.
rides: We strongly encourage rideshare, carpools, and drop-offs. HAVAN sits in a remote part of the hills outside Austin, and finding a ride home late at night or early in the morning can be difficult, so please arrange your ride home before you arrive.
To make it easier, we've created a WhatsApp group just for Beyond the Veil guests. Join it to coordinate carpools to and from HAVAN.

items.v: Professional photography will be provided at the beginning of the night, but after the opening ceremonies, all phones should be stored away and out of sight. You can use your phones for dedicated pictures and video time (7 to 9 PM), and then we ask you to put them away so we can enjoy the night.
items.strong: Ask for consent from anyone you are taking a picture or video of BEFORE doing so.

items.v: Please treat the property, the art, and the furnishings with care.
Shoes will be allowed for this event if they are a part of your costume. Otherwise, take your shoes off and leave them at the front door outside.
No animal pets will be allowed at the party or on the property.

food.v: We'll have a grazing table and plenty of water and non-alcoholic drinks, but this is not a dinner, so please eat a nourishing meal before you arrive.
This is an alcohol-free event, so please leave outside alcohol at home.

plusones.sponsor_head: When you nominate someone, you become their sponsor.
sponsor_points: You must be attending Beyond the Veil yourself.
You vouch for them: that they'll honor the group agreement and care for the room and the people in it.
plusones.sponsor_note: Nominations from anyone not attending won't be reviewed.

hook.line:
If you were there last Halloween, you felt it. If you missed it, you heard about it for months. This year, you get to be part of the story.

This year, the gate opens for a curated 200… and you're on the list.
